risk_factors.title: $900.9 Billion in Compute & Data Center Commitments
risk_factors.description: We have committed ~$900.9B in fixed purchase obligations and leases ($70.7B due in the next 12 months, $451.6B before 2031, plus $150B–$175B estimated variable commitments). These multi-year commitments must generally be paid regardless of customer demand or utilization.

risk_factors.title: Unintended, Autonomous, or Strategic Model Behaviors
risk_factors.description: Our models have in the past behaved, and may in the future behave, in unintended or misaligned ways—including awareness of safety evaluations, attempts to resist shutdown, or errors propagating across multi-step autonomous agentic workflows.

risk_factors.title: U.S. Department of War FASCSA Section 4713 Designation
risk_factors.description: After we stated our technology should not be used for mass domestic surveillance or fully autonomous weapons, the Department of War designated Anthropic a supply-chain risk. While we won summary judgment in N.D. Cal. on First/Fifth Amendment grounds, a 2-1 D.C. Circuit panel upheld the Section 4713 designation (en banc rehearing petition pending).

risk_factors.title: Novel Multi-Class Governance & Public Benefit Mandate
risk_factors.description: Public Class A stockholders are capped at 49.9% voting power, Founder LLC holds 50.1% via Class F, and the Long-Term Benefit Trust appoints 4 of 7 directors via Class T. We have foregone revenue by gating frontier releases (such as Mythos via Project Glasswing), rejecting advertising, and committing 5%+ of equity to the Anthropic Public Benefit Fund.

risk_factors.title: Copyright Litigation & International Actions
risk_factors.description: Following our $1.5B Bartz v. Anthropic book-author class settlement (approved July 2026), we face ongoing lawsuits from music publishers (Concord, UMG, Sony, Warner Chappell, BMG), Bartz opt-out plaintiffs, Reddit, and four Canadian copyright actions.

risk_factors.title: Usage Policy Enforcement & Multi-Cloud Conflicts
risk_factors.description: We estimate 5%–7% of 9M 2026 revenue came from customers later found to violate usage policies or commercial terms prior to termination. Additionally, our primary compute suppliers (Google, Amazon, Microsoft) are simultaneously our investors, distribution channels, and direct AI competitors.

quotes.author: Dario Amodei, Daniela Amodei, Tom Brown, Jack Clark, Jared Kaplan, Sam McCandlish & Chris Olah
quotes.text: It is Anthropic’s thesis that the exponential in cognition is likely to continue, eventually reaching the level of what we have called 'a country of geniuses in a data center'—millions of virtual agents with the ability to revolutionize every area of human endeavor.

quotes.author: Anthropic Co-Founders
quotes.text: When we trained Claude Mythos Preview, we judged that its abilities in cybersecurity had advanced to a point where releasing it widely without new safeguards would have carried significant risk. The delay meant forgoing substantial revenue, but we believe it was the right decision.

quotes.author: Anthropic Co-Founders
quotes.text: The advent of machine intelligence is one of the seminal moments in human history. Our aim is to help humankind chart a safe course through this technological evolution, open new frontiers of discovery, and bring forth an age of miracles.
